risks: A docstring that asserts a performance property is not evidence of it. NEX-086 documented revoked_grants as bounded while its body read every grant row; NEX-087, NEX-088 and NEX-092 were the same defect in three layers. Suspect a docstring promising bounding above a select() with no where(...).

Predicate pushdown is only safe when the domain predicate is a bare column test. is_revoked is `revoked_at is not None`, so `revoked_at IS NOT NULL` is its exact translation and the table's CheckConstraint(revoked_by IS NULL OR revoked_at IS NOT NULL) forbids the only incoherent row. is_active carries a clock and two nullable deadlines and must stay in Python.

ci.yml declares concurrency group ci-<workflow>-<ref> with cancel-in-progress: true. A docs push while the product commit's runs are in flight cancels them, leaving the product commit with zero or cancelled check-runs (the NEX-091 trap). Read the verdict before pushing docs.

An IdP subject is opaque and may contain '/', '@' or '+'. Never put one in a path segment: a subject-in-path route failed to match and answered 404 without reaching the use case, so an existing link looked absent rather than unaddressable.

Heredoc-fed publishers fail silently: a `cat > file << 'EOF'` body interleaves and truncates but `gh pr comment --body-file` still returns exit 0 and a URL (run 93 published one, caught by fetching the landed body and comparing line counts, then deleted and reposted). Write publishable prose with file_editor, never a heredoc.

The user memory index is 168 KB, ~28x its context budget, so injected memory is truncated and lessons from earlier runs are not visible. The failure is silent: the run believes it has memory and acts on a fraction of it.

Heredoc corruption is now a five-for-five failure mode and it struck again this run: a python heredoc self-interleaved and died with a SyntaxError, which was harmless only because it failed loudly before writing. Two consecutive runs have lost time to it. Use file_editor for any multi-line script or prose; treat a heredoc as unsupported in this environment.

decisions_this_run: The regression test observes work performed (_to_domain call count) rather than asserting on SQL text: a string assertion would pass for the wrong reason and pin the implementation, while the call count is the adapter's only row-to-domain path.
count_revoked became a count(*) aggregate so the port's 'without loading them' promise is actually kept; the WHERE clause is written once in the adapter, beside the one it must agree with.
is_active filtering stays in Python deliberately: it evaluates a clock against two nullable deadlines, which is real logic a SQL translation could drift from. is_revoked does not.
The docs push was deliberately delayed until the product commit's own runs concluded, because ci.yml cancels in-progress runs per ref.
